items.title: The Witcher 3's expansion reveal is scheduled for next month
items.description: CD Projekt Red sent us all scurrying for our calendars when it announced, last May, that 2015's The Witcher 3 would be getting a brand-new expansion in the year of our lord 2027. It's called Songs of the Past, it's set to be "a little bit closer to Blood and Wine" in terms of size, and it's being co-developed alongside Fool's Theory, the studio that's also remaking the first Witcher... Read more.
items.author: Joshua Wolens

items.title: CD Projekt Red's CEO still thinks they need to finish their post-Cyberpunk redemption arc, and he's hoping The Witcher 4 will help
items.description: I think despite the mess that was the launch of Cyberpunk 2077 , it wouldn't be right to say that CD Projekt Red's reputation was completely tarnished. It is still a game with a lot of cultural relevancy, and nobody can shut up about The Witcher 3 to such a degree that it's even getting a brand new expansion more than 10 years after the last one came out. Even still, it doesn't sound like joint CEO Michał Nowakowski is entirely convinced that the studio has managed to complete its redemption arc. Read more

items.title: This massively ambitious The Witcher 3 mod aims to recreate its biggest cut questline, and you could be the voice of Geralt of Rivia
items.description: The Witcher 3 isn't exactly short of stuff to do, but I nonetheless lament that one of its most ambitious questlines never made it into the final game. Not only because it would have delved much more deeply into The Catriona Plague—a disease ravaging Velen that mostly serves as a background event in the final game—but also because it would have brought back The Witcher 2 's best character, the elven rebel smokeshow Iorveth... Read more.
items.author: Rick Lane

items.title: Witcher 3 modders are restoring the RPG's massive cut plague questline, just in case CD Projekt's Songs of the Past expansion isn't enough extra Geralt
items.description: Those modders, eh? Never ones to be outdone. CD Projekt whip out a surprise extra DLC for The Witcher 3 following months of speculation, revealing it's set to arrive in 2027. Naturally, that's now also the point when a group of the RPG 's modders are planning to have an expansion-sized resurrection of a beefy questline CD Projekt cut from the initial version of TW3 fully up and running. They've got a demo out already. Read more

items.title: The Witcher 3 sold another 5 million copies over the last year: 'This cements its place among the best-selling videogames in history'
items.description: Here's a nice little bit of trivia to carry you into your weekend: Amidst all the hullabaloo about the surprise Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past that was announced earlier this week , CD Projekt also revealed that Geralt's big(gest) adventure has now surpassed 65 million copies sold... Read more.
items.author: Andy Chalk

items.title: 'Proper big': The Witcher 3's new expansion will be 'closer to Blood and Wine' in scope
items.description: CD Projekt finally confirmed yesterday that a new expansion for The Witcher 3 is in the works, called Songs of the Past . The announcement brought months of rumors and speculation (and one cheeky non-denial) to a close—ironically, a day earlier than planned, because CD Projekt accidentally let the big surprise leak out on its own storefront. Nobody to blame for that one but yourselves, fellas... Read more.
items.author: Andy Chalk

items.title: REDstreams — The Witcher 3: Blood and Wine 10th Anniversary Stream is coming!
items.description: Toussaint, the land of love and wine 🍷Join us on May 28th at 5 PM CEST for a special anniversary stream of The Witcher 3: Blood and Wine. Our hosts, Amelia Korzycka and Laura Beitzel, together with their guests Kacper Niepokólczycki and Magdalena Zych, will return once more to the land of knights, vineyards, and vampires!See you soon in Toussaint and in the chat!
items.author: Vattier

items.title: Witcher 3 modders have already added Geralt's new sword from the Songs of the Past expansion to the base game
items.description: Yesterday, May 27th, CD Projekt finally held their hands up and revealed that the extra DLC long-rumoured to be coming to The Witcher 3 is indeed a thing. It's called Songs of the Past and will arrive in 2027, they said, also lobbing out some promo art of Gerry from the River holding a sword in front of a spooky tree bloke. Cue a Witcher 3 modder cracking their knuckles and immediately getting to work re-creating the sword from the artwork and adding it to the RPG as a way for folks to celebrate the news. Read more

items.title: The Witcher 3 reveals new system requirements and it's now Windows 11 or nothing
items.description: CD Projekt finally confirmed today that it's working on a new expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt , called Songs of the Past, that's expected to be out sometime in 2027. As part of that announcement, the studio also said it's updating the game's system requirements "to ensure smooth performance and compatibility going forward.".. Read more.
items.author: Andy Chalk

items.description: As had been rumoured and now confirmed, CD PROJEKT RED today announced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past DLC to arrive in 2027. Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2026/05/the-witcher-3-wild-hunt-songs-of-the-past-dlc-announced/

items.title: Geralt's back for one last Roach ride in long-rumoured The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion Songs of the Past
items.description: Silver-haired fox of an RPG The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is officially getting a new expansion, ten years after Blood and Wine and over eleven since the base game launch. It’s called Songs of the Past , it’s being co-developed between CD Projekt Red and The Witcher 1 Remake devs Fool’s Theory, and its coming in 2027 – potentially the same trip round t’Sun as The Witcher 4 . Read more

items.title: CD Projekt Red confirms it's working on The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion after accidentally leaking it on its own storefront
items.description: The prophecy has been fulfilled. After much speculation CD Projekt has finally confirmed that it is indeed working on a Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion, going even further to confirm its release window as well... Read more.
items.author: Elie Gould

items.title: It's official, The Witcher 3 is getting new DLC, and it's a full-sized Geralt story
items.description: Can't wait for The Witcher 4? You won't have to. Long rumored and now confirmed, The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past is a new DLC for the all-conquering CD Projekt Red RPG. With the developer teasing an upcoming anniversary livestream celebrating ten years of the Blood and Wine expansion, we were expecting to hear something. In the end, CDPR decided to get out ahead of the moment and just announce it now. Read the full story on PCGamesN: It's official, The Witcher 3 is getting new DLC, and it's a full-sized Geralt story
items.author: editor@pcgamesn.com

items.title: Announcing The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
items.description: Medallion's humming... that can only mean one thing! It's time to announce we're working on a brand new expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt! Get ready to return to the Path with Geralt of Rivia in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past, coming in 2027. We’re currently co-developing the expansion with Fool’s Theory and we’ll share more in late summer, so stay tuned! With new content coming to the game, we also need to update our system requirements to ensure smooth performance and compatibility going forward for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and Songs of the Past. These requirements will become effective starting from the next update. You can find more about them here: https://thewitcher....

items.title: The Witcher 3 multiplayer mod's latest major update adds the only mount you'll ever need - your fellow players
items.description: All right, giddy up. My bum isn't digging into your shoulders too much, is it? No, sorry other Geralt, I was talking to Yen. How's she doing at the bottom of this flesh tower we've decided to form in The Witcher 3 's multiplayer mod? Ah, I see. Well, I can't print that sort of language, so I'm just going to write that she's really enjoying the latest major update to Witcher Online. Read more

items.title: Sick of The Witcher 3's Roach? Its MMO mod now lets you ride other players instead
items.description: I'll take any excuse to return to The Witcher 3 , and while multiplayer mod Witcher Online isn't the full co-op adventure I'd love to see CD Projekt Red consider for The Witcher 4, it brings a gleeful shared experience to the world. Inspired by MMORPGs , it fills your game with other players, setting you free to hang out in taverns, roleplay, or just get into scraps. The team behind it, helmed by modder 'rejuvenate,' has just launched a big 2.0 overhaul, which includes item trading, full syncing for horses, boats, and animal morphs, and even the ability to ride other players around town. Read the rest of the story... RELATED LINKS: Get ready for The Witcher 4 with this new, Ciri-led Witcher 3 ...

items.title: There's no secret Cyberpunk 2077 DLC coming, CD Projekt say, immediately setting themselves up for more nagging about secret Witcher 3 DLC
items.description: No. I, your dad, haven't bought you any Christmas presents. No, that isn't the wry smile of deceit you see nestled on my face. Yes, technically I could tell you that I haven't bought you any Christmas presents without that being a lie if, in fact, I knew that your mum was buying all of your Christmas presents, while I'm paying for some other bill we need to settle. No, I'm not going to go and get her so that you can specifically ask her whether she's bought you any Christmas presents. Why? Sorry, my lips are sealed.
